context: A teacher and student plan costumes for the school drama club
purpose: Teach: 衣装/脚本/デザイナー/スクリーン/スーツ/クラシック/編成/隠れ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: さくらさん、今年の演劇部の脚本、もう読んでくれた？
lines.en: Sakura, have you read this year's drama club script yet?
lines.style: Warm teacher opening, gentle inviting tone, soft trailing question.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、昨日読みました！舞台衣装のことを考えるとワクワクします。
lines.en: Yes, I read it yesterday! Thinking about the stage costumes excites me.
lines.style: Bright teen enthusiasm, slightly fast, rising energy at the end.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 良かった。実は衣装デザイナーをさくらさんに任せたいと思っているの。
lines.en: Glad to hear it. Actually, I'd like to entrust you as costume designer.
lines.style: Calm teacher confidence, softly persuasive, gentle and encouraging.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 本当ですか？主役にはクラシックなスーツを着せたいです、黒っぽい感じで。
lines.en: Really? I want to dress the lead in a classic suit, kind of dark.
lines.style: Excited teen pitching ideas, breathless, leaning forward visibly.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いいわね。背景のスクリーンに映る影とのバランスも考えてみて。
lines.en: Lovely. Also think about balance with the shadows projected on the screen.
lines.style: Thoughtful teacher guidance, measured pacing, eyes squinting in imagination.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: なるほど。隠れキャラの忍者役は地味めの色にしようかな。
lines.en: I see. Maybe I'll make the hidden ninja character's outfit more subdued.
lines.style: Teen thinking aloud, playful curiosity, tilting head while mumbling.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: うん、それなら衣装の編成全体に統一感が出るわね。
lines.en: Yes, that way the overall costume lineup will feel unified.
lines.style: Approving teacher nod, soft satisfaction, warm collaborative tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: じゃあ来週までにスケッチを描いて持ってきます！
lines.en: Then I'll draw up sketches and bring them by next week!
lines.style: Determined teen promise, voice firm and bright, ending with smile.
